title: Audit Skill Rule Definition Schema
description: JSON schema for validating audit rules used in the Claude Code audit skill

description.description: Short human-readable description of the rule

category.description: Category of recommendation (structure, naming, tooling, compliance, process, testing)

replacedBy.description: ID of the rule that replaces this one (if deprecated)

contextVars.description: Context variables that must match for this rule to apply

precedenceWeight.description: Weight for precedence scoring (1-100; higher = applies first)

recommendation.description: Plain English recommendation text (rendered as markdown)

path.description: File path to create (relative to project root)

template.description: Template ID or inline content for scaffolding

files.description: Optional files to scaffold or generate

enforcementLevel.description: Enforcement level: advisory (suggestion), soft-mandatory (strongly recommend), hard-mandatory (non-negotiable)

conflictsWith.description: List of rule IDs this rule conflicts with

overrides.description: List of rule IDs this rule always supersedes

rationale.description: Why this rule exists; used in conflict resolution explanations
